The Export button works now, and the fix is committed as `e2ec85a`.

**Cause:** `OrdersPage.__init__` in `src/orders-web/orders_page.py` registered only the `"refresh"` handler. Clicking `"export"` found no handler and did nothing.

**Fix:** I added `self._on("export", self.export)` next to the refresh registration.

**Test:** The existing export test called `page.export()` directly, so it never exercised the button and passed anyway. I added `test_export_button_writes_one_download`, which calls `page.click("export")`. It fails without the fix and passes with it. All 5 tests in `tests/test_orders_web.py` pass.
